triage.desk_query: Term sheet G07 states: "Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%." The booking record field autocall_level_pct is set to [100, 100, 100], i.e. a flat trigger, which does not reflect the stepping-down schedule. Please confirm the autocall barrier steps to 95% on 20 January 2028 and 90% on 20 July 2028, and rebook the field as [100, 95, 90] if so. If the flat 100% booking is intentional, identify the amendment or supplement that overrides the term sheet schedule.
triage.cited_clause: Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%.
triage.rationale: The term sheet states an explicit, unambiguous stepping schedule that both extractors agree on, so the flat booking is most likely a data-entry error in the booking record.
